description: Demolition of side extension and erection of part single, part 2-storey side and rear extensions, balustrades to first floor rear windows and new front porch.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
The external finishing materials shall match those used in the construction of the existing building and/or areas of hard surfacing. Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, as set out below:6EB-02-001, 6EB-02-002, 6EB-02-003, 6EB-02-004, 6EB-02-005Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The glazing serving the first floor side window shall be non opening below 1.7m of the finished floor level and in obscured glass with an equivalent obscuration as level 3 on the Pilkington Obscuration Range. The glazing shall not be altered without the approval in writing of the Local Planning Authority. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining and neighbouring properties.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no balustrades or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof of the extension(s). No roof of any part of the extension(s) shall be used for any recreational purpose and access shall only be for the purposes of the maintenance of the property or means of emergency escape. Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.
